<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions" targetNamespace="https://pulse.local/bpmn" exporter="PULSE" exporterVersion="0.1">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ClientApplication" name="Обработка заявки клиента" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Клиент отправляет заявку. Менеджер проверяет документы. Потом её проверяют юрист и служба безопасности. После этого руководитель принимает решение.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="P_Client" name="Клиент"/>
      <bpmn:lane id="P_Manager" name="Менеджер">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>N_Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_Parallel_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_Parallel_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Manager_NotifyClient_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Manager_NotifyClient_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Manager_CheckDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="P_Lawyer" name="Юрист">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Lawyer_CheckApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="P_Security" name="Служба_безопасности">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Security_CheckApplication</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="P_Head" name="Руководитель">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Cost_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_Cost_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Head_AdditionalApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T_Head_MakeDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>G_Exclusive_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E_End_Approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E_End_Rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="N_Start" name="Заявка клиента поступила">
      <bpmn:documentation>Клиент отправляет заявку.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_Start_to_ManagerCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="G_Parallel_Split" name="Разделение на проверки" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:documentation>Потом её проверяют юрист и служба безопасности.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ManagerCheck_to_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ParallelSplit_to_LawyerCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ParallelSplit_to_SecurityCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Lawyer_CheckApplication" name="Проверить заявку (Юрист)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Потом её проверяют юрист и служба безопасности.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ParallelSplit_to_LawyerCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_LawyerCheck_to_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Security_CheckApplication" name="Проверить заявку (Служба безопасности)">
      <bpmn:documentation>Потом её проверяют юрист и служба безопасности.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ParallelSplit_to_SecurityCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_SecurityCheck_to_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="G_Parallel_Join" name="Объединение проверок" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_LawyerCheck_to_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_SecurityCheck_to_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ParallelJoin_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Cost_Check" name="Проверить стоимость договора">
      <bpmn:documentation>Проверка стоимости > 500 000 рублей</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_ParallelJoin_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CostCheck_to_CostDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_Cost_Decision" name="Проверка стоимости > 500 000 рублей" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="F_CostDecision_to_HeadDecision">
      <bpmn:documentation>Проверка стоимости > 500 000 рублей</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CostCheck_to_CostDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CostDecision_to_AdditionalApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_CostDecision_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Head_AdditionalApproval" name="Дополнительное согласование руководителем">
      <bpmn:documentation>Дополнительное согласование руководителем при стоимости > 500 000 рублей</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CostDecision_to_AdditionalApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_AdditionalApproval_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Head_MakeDecision" name="Принять решение">
      <bpmn:documentation>После этого руководитель принимает решение.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_CostDecision_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_AdditionalApproval_to_HeadDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_HeadDecision_to_ExclusiveGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="G_Exclusive_Decision" name="Решение руководителя" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="F_Decision_to_RejectedEnd">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_HeadDecision_to_ExclusiveGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_Decision_to_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_Decision_to_RejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Approved" name="Уведомить клиента об одобрении">
      <bpmn:documentation>При одобрении менеджер уведомляет клиента об одобрении</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_Decision_to_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_NotifyClientApproved_to_EndApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Rejected" name="Уведомить клиента об отказе">
      <bpmn:documentation>При отказе менеджер уведомляет клиента об отказе</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_Decision_to_RejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_NotifyClientRejected_to_EndRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E_End_Approved" name="Заявка одобрена">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_NotifyClientApproved_to_EndApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E_End_Rejected" name="Заявка отклонена">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_NotifyClientRejected_to_EndRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="T_Manager_CheckDocuments" name="Проверить документы">
      <bpmn:documentation>Менеджер проверяет документы.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>F_Start_to_ManagerCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F_ManagerCheck_to_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Start_to_ManagerCheck" sourceRef="N_Start" targetRef="T_Manager_CheckDocuments" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ManagerCheck_to_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="T_Manager_CheckDocuments" targetRef="G_Parallel_Split" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ParallelSplit_to_LawyerCheck" sourceRef="G_Parallel_Split" targetRef="T_Lawyer_CheckApplication" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ParallelSplit_to_SecurityCheck" sourceRef="G_Parallel_Split" targetRef="T_Security_CheckApplication" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_LawyerCheck_to_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="T_Lawyer_CheckApplication" targetRef="G_Parallel_Join" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_SecurityCheck_to_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="T_Security_CheckApplication" targetRef="G_Parallel_Join" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_ParallelJoin_to_HeadDecision" sourceRef="G_Parallel_Join" targetRef="T_Cost_Check" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CostCheck_to_CostDecision" sourceRef="T_Cost_Check" targetRef="G_Cost_Decision" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CostDecision_to_AdditionalApproval" sourceRef="G_Cost_Decision" targetRef="T_Head_AdditionalApproval" name="Стоимость > 500000">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Стоимость > 500000</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_CostDecision_to_HeadDecision" sourceRef="G_Cost_Decision" targetRef="T_Head_MakeDecision" name="Стоимость <= 500000"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_AdditionalApproval_to_HeadDecision" sourceRef="T_Head_AdditionalApproval" targetRef="T_Head_MakeDecision" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_HeadDecision_to_ExclusiveGateway" sourceRef="T_Head_MakeDecision" targetRef="G_Exclusive_Decision" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Decision_to_ApprovedEnd" sourceRef="G_Exclusive_Decision" targetRef="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Approved" name="Одобрено">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Решение = Одобрено</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_Decision_to_RejectedEnd" sourceRef="G_Exclusive_Decision" targetRef="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Rejected" name="Отклонено"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NotifyClientApproved_to_EndApproved" sourceRef="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Approved" targetRef="E_End_Approved" name=""/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_NotifyClientRejected_to_EndRejected" sourceRef="T_Manager_NotifyClient_Rejected" targetRef="E_End_Rejected" name=""/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Pool" name="Обработка заявки клиента" processRef="Process_ClientApplication"/>
